dimensions.title: Pillar 1: School Feeding
dimensions.summary: 53.5% of monitored learners demonstrated practical recall of school meal protection, balanced plates, and METU-1 multi-mix porridge enrichment using locally available foods.
evidence_points: Protecting school meals: 115 learners recalled specific local greens (Eboo, Lokaka) and cowpeas for METU-1 porridge fortification
Balanced plate & clubs: 22 active NutriClubs established with demo gardens; OFSP & iron-rich beans tracked (9 OFSP, 10 iron beans logged)
Helpline awareness: WFP toll-free helpline (0800 210 210) promoted across 9 schools for reporting meal theft or mismanagement (0 complaints logged)

dimensions.title: Pillar 2: Gender
dimensions.summary: 60.3% consensus recorded across male allies (boys, fathers, male teachers) affirming fair sharing at the table and in the classroom, addressing practical constraints (labour, cost, menstruation).
evidence_points: Fair sharing at the table: 129 of 181 interviewed learners affirmed boys and girls must eat equally and simultaneously
Male allies in action: 19,422 boy responses logged across 5 micro-polls with 96.7% agreement (18,778 agreements) committing to share morning water and firewood chores
Addressing practical constraints: Dialogues with fathers and male teachers tackling domestic labour (19,422 boys), schooling costs (15 sessions), and menstrual hygiene (4 sessions)

dimensions.title: Pillar 3: Community Engagement
dimensions.summary: 144.4% of school leadership and VHTs agreed on joint action calendars, driving community behaviour change across 640 targeted cooking demonstrations.
evidence_points: 640 Cooking Demonstrations target led by 256 VHT/lead-mother pairs (rollout underway; 11 sessions with lead mothers co-facilitating)
Community dialogues with men & elders: 13 of 9 schools established joint 4-week action plans and consensus
Clean & smart cooking practices: Retained-heat cooking, dry firewood management, and moving away from open 3-stone fires promoted
METU-1 recipe chart routine: 1,436 take-home NutriCharts issued for household routine adoption
